summary: Currenc Group's wholly owned Seamless unit reinstated and amended its January 1, 2026 share purchase agreement with New Margin Holding for Tranglo Sdn. Bhd., extending the longstop date to March 31, 2027 after the original September 30, 2026 deadline lapsed unsatisfied. The original deal covered 100,465 shares, 60% of Tranglo, for US$400 million cash; the parties now agree in principle to New Margin acquiring 100% for US$666,666,666.67, pro rata, targeting a Tripartite Agreement with tag-along holder Ripple Markets APAC by December 31, 2026. Watch the Malaya charging order, RMA settlement and HKIAC arbitration risk.
